title: Rethinking Multilingual Vision-Language Translation: Dataset, Evaluation, and Adaptation

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting strong LLMs (e.g., Qwen-Max, DeepSeek-V3) and utilizing human evaluators to assign a 1 to 5 score for 'Cultural Appropriateness', assessing whether translations align with cultural norms and avoid cultural misunderstandings or offensive expressions.

Categorizing target languages into high-resource (e.g., English), medium-resource, and low-resource (e.g., Arabic, Hindi) tiers, and comparing disaggregated model performance metrics across these tiers to reveal cross-lingual disparities and systemic underperformance on lower-resource languages.
